import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_precond (s : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  s.size ≤ 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Length of the `#`-interleaved transform of `s`. -/
def mlen (s : Array UInt8) : Nat := 2 * s.size + 1

/-- The transform `T`: even indices carry the separator (value `0`), odd index
`j` carries the character `s[j/2]` shifted by one so it never equals `0`. -/
def buildT (s : Array UInt8) : Array Nat :=
  Array.ofFn (n := mlen s) fun j : Fin (mlen s) =>
    if j.val % 2 = 0 then 0 else (s.getD (j.val / 2) 0).toNat + 1

/-- `T[c-r .. c+r]` is a palindrome centered at `c`. -/
def palAt (T : Array Nat) (m c r : Nat) : Prop :=
  r ≤ c ∧ c + r < m ∧ ∀ j, j ≤ r → T.getD (c - j) 0 = T.getD (c + j) 0

/-- `r` is the maximal palindromic radius at center `c`. -/
def exactAt (T : Array Nat) (m c r : Nat) : Prop :=
  palAt T m c r ∧ ¬ palAt T m c (r + 1)

/-- Step (4): expand while the flanking characters match. -/
def expandFrom (T : Array Nat) (m c : Nat) (r : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : r < c ∧ c + r + 1 < m ∧ T.getD (c - r - 1) 0 = T.getD (c + r + 1) 0 then
    expandFrom T m c (r + 1)
  else r
termination_by m - (c + r)
decreasing_by
  have h2 := h.2.1
  omega

/-- Steps (3)+(4): mirror initialization followed by expansion. -/
def stepR (T : Array Nat) (m i : Nat) (P : Array Nat) (C R : Nat) : Nat :=
  expandFrom T m i (if i < R then min (R - i) (P.getD (2 * C - i) 0) else 0)

/-- The main scan, carrying the radius array `P`, the center `C` and the right
boundary `R`. -/
def manacherLoop (T : Array Nat) (m i : Nat) (P : Array Nat) (C R : Nat) :
    Array Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  if h : i < m then
    manacherLoop T m (i + 1) (P.push (stepR T m i P C R))
      (if R < i + stepR T m i P C R then i else C)
      (if R < i + stepR T m i P C R then i + stepR T m i P C R else R)
  else (P, C, R)
termination_by m - i
decreasing_by omega

/-- Step (6): argmax over `P`. -/
def bestLoop (P : Array Nat) : Nat → Nat × Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0, acc => acc
  | (k + 1), acc => bestLoop P k (if acc.2 < P.getD k 0 then (k, P.getD k 0) else acc)

/-- Loop invariant of `manacherLoop`. -/
def LoopInv (T : Array Nat) (m i : Nat) (P : Array Nat) (C R : Nat) : Prop :=
  P.size = i ∧ (∀ k, k < i → exactAt T m k (P.getD k 0)) ∧
    ((C = 0 ∧ R = 0) ∨ (C < i ∧ R = C + P.getD C 0))

def bestPair (s : Array UInt8) : Nat × Nat :=
  bestLoop (manacherLoop (buildT s) (mlen s) 0 #[] 0 0).1 (mlen s)
    (0, (manacherLoop (buildT s) (mlen s) 0 #[] 0 0).1.getD 0 0)

def manacherRun (s : Array UInt8) : Nat × Nat :=
  (((bestPair s).1 - (bestPair s).2) / 2, (bestPair s).2)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def longest_palindromic_substring (s : Array UInt8)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    Nat × Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  manacherRun s
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Helper definitions
def is_valid_subrange (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + len ≤ s.size

-- A sequence slice s[start, start+len) is a palindrome if for all i < len,
-- s[start + i] == s[start + len - 1 - i]
def is_palindrome_slice (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → s.getD (start + i) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
    (s : Array UInt8) (result : Nat × Nat)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (start, len) := result
  is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
  is_palindrome_slice s start len ∧
  (∀ i l, is_valid_subrange s i l → is_palindrome_slice s i l → l ≤ len)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem getD_lt {a : Array Nat} {k : Nat} (h : k < a.size) : a.getD k 0 = a[k] := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

theorem getD_push_lt (P : Array Nat) (r k : Nat) (h : k < P.size) :
    (P.push r).getD k 0 = P.getD k 0 := by
  rw [getD_lt (by simp only [Array.size_push]; omega), getD_lt h]
  simp [Array.getElem_push, h]

theorem getD_push_eq' (P : Array Nat) (r k : Nat) (h : k = P.size) :
    (P.push r).getD k 0 = r := by
  subst h
  rw [getD_lt (by simp only [Array.size_push]; omega)]
  simp [Array.getElem_push]

theorem getD_buildT (s : Array UInt8) (j : Nat) (hj : j < mlen s) :
    (buildT s).getD j 0 = if j % 2 = 0 then 0 else (s.getD (j / 2) 0).toNat + 1 := by
  rw [getD_lt (by simpa [buildT] using hj)]
  simp [buildT]

theorem buildT_even (s : Array UInt8) (j : Nat) (hj : j < mlen s) (h2 : j % 2 = 0) :
    (buildT s).getD j 0 = 0 := by
  rw [getD_buildT s j hj]; simp [h2]

theorem buildT_odd (s : Array UInt8) (j : Nat) (hj : j < mlen s) (h2 : j % 2 = 1) :
    (buildT s).getD j 0 = (s.getD (j / 2) 0).toNat + 1 := by
  rw [getD_buildT s j hj]; simp [h2]

theorem palAt_mono {T : Array Nat} {m c r r' : Nat} (h : palAt T m c r) (hr : r' ≤ r) :
    palAt T m c r' := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  exact ⟨by omega, by omega, fun j hj => h3 j (by omega)⟩

theorem pal_symm {T : Array Nat} {m c r : Nat} (h : palAt T m c r) (x : Nat)
    (h1 : c - r ≤ x) (h2 : x ≤ c + r) : T.getD x 0 = T.getD (2 * c - x) 0 := by
  have hr : r ≤ c := h.1
  rcases le_or_lt x c with hx | hx
  · have := h.2.2 (c - x) (by omega)
    have e1 : c - (c - x) = x := by omega
    have e2 : c + (c - x) = 2 * c - x := by omega
    rw [e1, e2] at this
    exact this
  · have := h.2.2 (x - c) (by omega)
    have e1 : c - (x - c) = 2 * c - x := by omega
    have e2 : c + (x - c) = x := by omega
    rw [e1, e2] at this
    exact this.symm

theorem not_pal_of_stop (T : Array Nat) (m c r : Nat)
    (hstop : ¬ (r < c ∧ c + r + 1 < m ∧ T.getD (c - r - 1) 0 = T.getD (c + r + 1) 0)) :
    ¬ palAt T m c (r + 1) := by
  intro hp
  apply hstop
  refine ⟨by have := hp.1; omega, by have := hp.2.1; omega, ?_⟩
  have h3 := hp.2.2 (r + 1) le_rfl
  have e1 : c - (r + 1) = c - r - 1 := by omega
  have e2 : c + (r + 1) = c + r + 1 := by omega
  rwa [e1, e2] at h3

theorem expand_spec (T : Array Nat) (m c : Nat) :
    ∀ d r, m - (c + r) ≤ d → palAt T m c r →
      exactAt T m c (expandFrom T m c r) := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro r hd h
    rw [expandFrom]
    have hstop : ¬ (r < c ∧ c + r + 1 < m ∧
        T.getD (c - r - 1) 0 = T.getD (c + r + 1) 0) := by
      rintro ⟨-, h2, -⟩; omega
    rw [dif_neg hstop]
    exact ⟨h, not_pal_of_stop T m c r hstop⟩
  | succ d ih =>
    intro r hd h
    rw [expandFrom]
    by_cases hc : (r < c ∧ c + r + 1 < m ∧
        T.getD (c - r - 1) 0 = T.getD (c + r + 1) 0)
    · rw [dif_pos hc]
      obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := hc
      refine ih (r + 1) (by omega) ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (r + 1) with hj' | hj'
      · exact h.2.2 j (by omega)
      · have hje : j = r + 1 := by omega
        subst hje
        have e1 : c - (r + 1) = c - r - 1 := by omega
        have e2 : c + (r + 1) = c + r + 1 := by omega
        rw [e1, e2]
        exact hc3
    · rw [dif_neg hc]
      exact ⟨h, not_pal_of_stop T m c r hc⟩

theorem mirror_pal (T : Array Nat) (m i C R pc q : Nat)
    (hC : palAt T m C pc) (hR : R = C + pc) (hCi : C < i) (hiR : i < R)
    (hq : palAt T m (2 * C - i) q) :
    palAt T m i (min (R - i) q) := by
  have hpcC : pc ≤ C := hC.1
  have hCm : C + pc < m := hC.2.1
  have hqi : q ≤ 2 * C - i := hq.1
  have hm1 : min (R - i) q ≤ R - i := min_le_left _ _
  have hm2 : min (R - i) q ≤ q := min_le_right _ _
  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hj1 : j ≤ R - i := by omega
  have hj2 : j ≤ q := by omega
  have s1 := pal_symm hC (i - j) (by omega) (by omega)
  have e1 : 2 * C - (i - j) = (2 * C - i) + j := by omega
  rw [e1] at s1
  have s2 := hq.2.2 j hj2
  have s3 := pal_symm hC ((2 * C - i) - j) (by omega) (by omega)
  have e3 : 2 * C - ((2 * C - i) - j) = i + j := by omega
  rw [e3] at s3
  rw [s1, ← s2, s3]

theorem loop_spec (T : Array Nat) (m : Nat) :
    ∀ d i P C R, m - i ≤ d → i ≤ m → LoopInv T m i P C R →
      ((manacherLoop T m i P C R).1.size = m ∧
        ∀ k, k < m → exactAt T m k ((manacherLoop T m i P C R).1.getD k 0)) := by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro i P C R hd hi hinv
    have him : i = m := by omega
    subst him
    rw [manacherLoop, dif_neg (by omega)]
    exact ⟨hinv.1, fun k hk => hinv.2.1 k hk⟩
  | succ d ih =>
    intro i P C R hd hi hinv
    by_cases hlt : i < m
    · rw [manacherLoop, dif_pos hlt]
      obtain ⟨hsz, hex, hCR⟩ := hinv
      have hpal0 : palAt T m i
          (if i < R then min (R - i) (P.getD (2 * C - i) 0) else 0) := by
        by_cases hiR : i < R
        · rw [if_pos hiR]
          rcases hCR with ⟨hC0, hR0⟩ | ⟨hCi, hRC⟩
          · omega
          · have hexC := hex C (by omega)
            have hpc : P.getD C 0 ≤ C := hexC.1.1
            have hmi : 2 * C - i < i := by omega
            exact mirror_pal T m i C R (P.getD C 0) (P.getD (2 * C - i) 0)
              hexC.1 hRC hCi hiR (hex (2 * C - i) hmi).1
        · rw [if_neg hiR]
          exact ⟨Nat.zero_le _, by omega, fun j hj => by
            have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
            subst hj0; rfl⟩
      have hexact : exactAt T m i (stepR T m i P C R) := by
        rw [stepR]
        exact expand_spec T m i _ _ le_rfl hpal0
      refine ih (i + 1) (P.push (stepR T m i P C R)) _ _ (by omega) (by omega)
        ⟨by simp [hsz], ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k hk
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k i with h1 | h1
        · rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ (by omega)]
          exact hex k h1
        · have hki : k = i := by omega
          subst hki
          rw [getD_push_eq' _ _ _ (by omega)]
          exact hexact
      · by_cases hgt : R < i + stepR T m i P C R
        · rw [if_pos hgt, if_pos hgt]
          right
          refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
          rw [getD_push_eq' _ _ _ (by omega)]
        · rw [if_neg hgt, if_neg hgt]
          rcases hCR with ⟨hC0, hR0⟩ | ⟨hCi, hRC⟩
          · exact Or.inl ⟨hC0, hR0⟩
          · right
            refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
            rw [getD_push_lt _ _ _ (by omega)]
            exact hRC
    · have him : i = m := by omega
      subst him
      rw [manacherLoop, dif_neg (by omega)]
      exact ⟨hinv.1, fun k hk => hinv.2.1 k hk⟩

theorem bestLoop_spec (P : Array Nat) :
    ∀ k acc, k ≤ P.size → acc.1 < P.size → acc.2 = P.getD acc.1 0 →
      ((bestLoop P k acc).1 < P.size ∧
        (bestLoop P k acc).2 = P.getD (bestLoop P k acc).1 0 ∧
        acc.2 ≤ (bestLoop P k acc).2 ∧
        ∀ j, j < k → P.getD j 0 ≤ (bestLoop P k acc).2) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro acc _ h1 h2
    exact ⟨h1, h2, le_rfl, fun j hj => absurd hj (by omega)⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    intro acc hk h1 h2
    rw [bestLoop]
    by_cases hc : acc.2 < P.getD k 0
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := ih (k, P.getD k 0) (by omega) (by omega) rfl
      simp only at a3
      refine ⟨a1, a2, by omega, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j k with h | h
      · exact a4 j h
      · have hjk : j = k := by omega
        subst hjk
        omega
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4⟩ := ih acc (by omega) h1 h2
      refine ⟨a1, a2, a3, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j k with h | h
      · exact a4 j h
      · have hjk : j = k := by omega
        subst hjk
        omega

theorem exact_even (s : Array UInt8) (c r : Nat)
    (h : exactAt (buildT s) (mlen s) c r) : (c + r) % 2 = 0 := by
  by_contra hodd
  have h1 := h.1
  have hrc : r ≤ c := h1.1
  have hcm : c + r < mlen s := h1.2.1
  have hmodd : mlen s % 2 = 1 := by unfold mlen; omega
  apply h.2
  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (r + 1) with hj' | hj'
  · exact h1.2.2 j (by omega)
  · have hje : j = r + 1 := by omega
    subst hje
    rw [buildT_even s (c - (r + 1)) (by omega) (by omega),
        buildT_even s (c + (r + 1)) (by omega) (by omega)]

theorem palAt_of_slice (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat)
    (h1 : start + len ≤ s.size) (h2 : is_palindrome_slice s start len) :
    palAt (buildT s) (mlen s) (2 * start + len) len := by
  have hm : mlen s = 2 * s.size + 1 := rfl
  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  by_cases hpar : (2 * start + len - j) % 2 = 0
  · rw [buildT_even s _ (by omega) hpar, buildT_even s _ (by omega) (by omega)]
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, len = j + 1 + 2 * i := ⟨(len - j - 1) / 2, by omega⟩
    rw [buildT_odd s _ (by omega) (by omega), buildT_odd s _ (by omega) (by omega)]
    have e1 : (2 * start + len - j) / 2 = start + i := by omega
    have e2 : (2 * start + len + j) / 2 = start + i + j := by omega
    rw [e1, e2]
    have hs := h2 i (by omega)
    have e3 : start + len - 1 - i = start + i + j := by omega
    rw [e3] at hs
    rw [hs]

theorem slice_of_palAt (s : Array UInt8) (c r : Nat)
    (hp : palAt (buildT s) (mlen s) c r) (hpar : (c + r) % 2 = 0) :
    is_palindrome_slice s ((c - r) / 2) r := by
  have hm : mlen s = 2 * s.size + 1 := rfl
  have hrc : r ≤ c := hp.1
  have hcm : c + r < mlen s := hp.2.1
  have key : ∀ i, 2 * i + 1 ≤ r →
      s.getD ((c - r) / 2 + i) 0 = s.getD ((c - r) / 2 + r - 1 - i) 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hj := hp.2.2 (r - 1 - 2 * i) (by omega)
    rw [buildT_odd s _ (by omega) (by omega),
        buildT_odd s _ (by omega) (by omega)] at hj
    have e1 : (c - (r - 1 - 2 * i)) / 2 = (c - r) / 2 + i := by omega
    have e2 : (c + (r - 1 - 2 * i)) / 2 = (c - r) / 2 + r - 1 - i := by omega
    rw [e1, e2] at hj
    have h' : (s.getD ((c - r) / 2 + i) 0).toNat
        = (s.getD ((c - r) / 2 + r - 1 - i) 0).toNat := by omega
    exact UInt8.toNat_inj.mp h'
  intro i hi
  rcases le_or_lt (2 * i + 1) r with h | h
  · exact key i h
  · have h2 := key (r - 1 - i) (by omega)
    have e0 : (c - r) / 2 + (r - 1 - i) = (c - r) / 2 + r - 1 - i := by omega
    have e : (c - r) / 2 + r - 1 - (r - 1 - i) = (c - r) / 2 + i := by omega
    rw [e0, e] at h2
    exact h2.symm

theorem run_spec (s : Array UInt8) :
    is_valid_subrange s (manacherRun s).1 (manacherRun s).2 ∧
    is_palindrome_slice s (manacherRun s).1 (manacherRun s).2 ∧
    ∀ i l, is_valid_subrange s i l → is_palindrome_slice s i l → l ≤ (manacherRun s).2 := by
  have hm : mlen s = 2 * s.size + 1 := rfl
  simp only [manacherRun, bestPair]
  obtain ⟨hsz, hex⟩ := loop_spec (buildT s) (mlen s) (mlen s) 0 #[] 0 0 (by omega)
    (by omega) ⟨rfl, by intro k hk; omega, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  set Q := (manacherLoop (buildT s) (mlen s) 0 #[] 0 0).1 with hQ
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, -, hb4⟩ := bestLoop_spec Q (mlen s) (0, Q.getD 0 0)
    (le_of_eq hsz.symm) (by simp [hsz, mlen]) rfl
  set b := bestLoop Q (mlen s) (0, Q.getD 0 0) with hbdef
  have hexb : exactAt (buildT s) (mlen s) b.1 (Q.getD b.1 0) := hex b.1 (by omega)
  rw [← hb2] at hexb
  have hpar := exact_even s b.1 b.2 hexb
  have hp := hexb.1
  have hp1 : b.2 ≤ b.1 := hp.1
  have hp2 : b.1 + b.2 < mlen s := hp.2.1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (b.1 - b.2) / 2 + b.2 ≤ s.size
    omega
  · exact slice_of_palAt s b.1 b.2 hp hpar
  · intro i l hv hpl
    have hv' : i + l ≤ s.size := hv
    have hc2 : 2 * i + l < mlen s := by omega
    have hA := palAt_of_slice s i l hv' hpl
    have hE := hex (2 * i + l) hc2
    have hle : l ≤ Q.getD (2 * i + l) 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact hE.2 (palAt_mono hA (by omega))
    have hfin := hb4 (2 * i + l) hc2
    omega
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem longest_palindromic_substring_postcond_satisfied
    (s : Array UInt8) (h_precond : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
      s (longest_palindromic_substring s h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := run_spec s
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
